title: India’s MeitY Sanctions ₹99.94 Crore ($10.3 Million USD) for IIT Madras and izmo Microsystems Silicon Photonics Program - Quantum Computing Report
gist: India's MeitY sanctioned ₹99.94 crore (~$10.3M) for Phase II (SPECTRA) of IIT Madras' CPPICS silicon photonics center with packaging partner izmo Microsystems. The program targets a 100+ IP block PDK on 200 mm wafers, 1.6 Tbps transceivers and co-packaged optics for AI clusters, plus a quantum communications workstream (QRNG, QKD).

insights.claim: MeitY sanctioned ₹99.94 crore (~$10.3M) for the five-year SPECTRA Phase II of IIT Madras' CPPICS, with MeitY providing ₹97.54 crore and izmo Microsystems ₹2.40 crore.
insights.speaker: Mohamed Abdel-Kareem
insights.so_what: Modest, almost entirely state-funded; private co-funding is token at ~2.4%.
insights.locator: The Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology

insights.claim: Phase II targets a silicon photonics PDK with over 100 IP blocks for 200 mm wafer platforms.
insights.speaker: Mohamed Abdel-Kareem
insights.so_what: A domestic PDK is foundational for an Indian photonics design ecosystem.

themes.theme: AI interconnect and quantum comms use cases

insights.claim: The program addresses 1.6 Tbps data center transceivers at 1550 nm and co-packaged optics for AI compute clusters.
insights.speaker: Mohamed Abdel-Kareem
insights.so_what: AI cluster optics demand is the commercial driver; quantum is a side workstream.

insights.claim: A dedicated quantum communications workstream targets chip-scale QRNGs and integrated QKD photonic circuits.
insights.speaker: Mohamed Abdel-Kareem
insights.so_what: India is building indigenous quantum-security hardware capability.

insights.claim: izmo Microsystems will lead precision assembly, fiber attach, PIC-EIC co-integration and thermal packaging, aiming for a certified co-packaged optics packaging service from foundry to system integration.
insights.speaker: Mohamed Abdel-Kareem
insights.so_what: Packaging is the commercial bottleneck in silicon photonics; izmo positions in that chokepoint.
